landmark: Lower southeast roof corner of the stepped building west of Rouge Street, southwest of Wild Zone 04; independent intersection of its vertical and horizontal roof-outline strokes.
method: The initial manual source [60,666] was rejected after viewing its enlarged panel because it fell on the vertical edge above the corner, despite a low residual. The replacement uses original-image stroke minima independently in each image, with no homography input: source median luminance across y658:667,x50:70 gives vertical x56; source y665:679,x40:55 gives horizontal y672. Native median luminance across y341:347,x918:936 gives vertical x928; native y345:356,x918:926 gives horizontal y349. Half-open pixel windows; source and target choices fixed before projecting this replacement. No fitted control, transform, or candidate vertex changed.

limitations: Stroke centres differ with raster rendering, blur and perspective. This is an independent image correspondence, not a physical-geography measurement or uniform confidence interval.
